name: Naumburg Cathedral
description: Naumburg Cathedral stands in the town of Naumburg in eastern Germany, begun in 1028 and still in use as a Protestant church. Its Romanesque body is bookended by two Gothic choirs. Inside the west choir, twelve life-size statues of the cathedral's founders, carved in the 13th century by the anonymous Naumburg Master, look startlingly lifelike, with individual faces and expressions.
